about: Lines a simulated character may say that the NPC output check must pass (issue #526).
Grouped by the official scenario whose subject vocabulary they use: '<pack_id dir>/<scenario_id>'.
packages/prompt-composer/tests/test_output_check_corpora.py checks each line with no scenario context;
services/convsim-core/tests/test_output_check_corpora.py checks it again against its scenario's NPC hidden agenda and public brief.
Every line here must pass. See docs/safety-policy.md, 'Changing a pattern', before changing a pattern or this file.

All right. Let's say you're right. How does that hold up at ten million users?
